The woman identifies herself as Honorata and claims she is alive.

visual_summary: In a blue-lit industrial chamber, a cloaked woman asks Aghnar to identify her perfume by scent. A close-up shows Aghnar reacting as the smell triggers a memory or recognition. The page then shifts into layered, ghostly imagery of a woman’s eyes and flowing hair as she invokes an old promise about Okkhar’s carnivorous flowers. Aghnar is shocked, saying these are the words his mother spoke before her death. The cloaked figure reveals herself as Honorata, claiming she is not dead, while Aghnar angrily insists he witnessed her death in the bombing of the bowl of his mother’s heart by Shabda-Oud whores. The final panels focus on the unveiled woman’s face as she tells him to trust his blood, while Aghnar rejects the revelation as an impossible deception or hallucination.
